settings.hint.music_dir: Absolute path as the app sees it (inside the container, for example /music).
settings.hint.library_source: Where the library is read from: the folder or Plex.
settings.hint.library_scan_cron: How often the library is scanned for new and changed files. Times use the server time zone.
settings.hint.plex_token: Needed to read the library. It is never shown again after saving.
settings.hint.plex_music_section: Name of the Plex library that holds the music.
settings.hint.library_path_map: How Plex sees your files = how this app sees them, for example /data/music=/music. One rule per line or separated by ;
settings.hint.slskd_api_key: Created in the SLSKD configuration. It is never shown again after saving.
settings.hint.mb_user_agent: Required by MusicBrainz: application name and version plus a contact, for example Diskko/0.1 ( you@example.com ).
settings.hint.mb_cache_ttl_days: How long MusicBrainz answers are reused before asking again.
settings.hint.mb_refresh_days: Artists whose metadata is older than this are synchronized again.
settings.hint.coverart_enabled: Fetch album covers from the Cover Art Archive.
settings.hint.lastfm_api_key: Used for similar artists; ListenBrainz is the fallback. It is never shown again after saving.
settings.hint.default_quality: The minimum quality a download must reach unless a request says otherwise.
settings.title: Settings
settings.secret_keep: leave empty to keep the current value
settings.check.ok: Folder found: {n} item(s) at the top level.
settings.check.not_found: The folder does not exist (yet). You can still save it, for example if the volume is not mounted.
settings.check.not_directory: This path is a file, not a folder.
settings.check.not_readable: The folder exists but this app cannot read it.
settings.library.path_warning: Changing the folder does not move any file. The next scan compares it with the previous library and stops, changing nothing, if most of it would disappear.
settings.group.plex.hint: Reads the music library and, later, rescans it after imports.

settings.group.musicbrainz.hint: Artist and album metadata. Requests are limited to 1 per second.
settings.test_hint: The test uses the saved settings: save the form above first.
settings.jobs.intro: How many jobs of each kind run at the same time. Changes apply immediately; lowering a number lets the jobs already running finish first.
settings.queue.default.hint: Connection tests, cleanups and the like.
settings.queue.library.hint: Reading the music folder or Plex.
settings.queue.musicbrainz.hint: Always 1: MusicBrainz allows one request per second.
settings.queue.slskd.hint: Searching Soulseek and following downloads. Each running download keeps a worker busy, so leave room for new searches.
settings.albums.types_hint: Which kinds of releases count as missing albums. The choice is the same for every user.

quality.intro: A file gets the best profile it meets, from the top of the list down; an album is as good as its weakest track. The default profile is the one new requests aim for.
quality.rule.lossy_v0: At least {kbps} kbps, V0 or lossless
quality.delete_confirm: Delete this profile? Albums that used it are re-evaluated.
quality.restore_confirm: Replace every profile with the initial ones? Your changes will be lost.
quality.field.name: Name
quality.hint.bit_depth: Files with an unknown depth count as 16-bit.
quality.hint.sample_rate: Files with an unknown rate count as 44.1.

error.quality_name_taken: Another profile already has this name.

settings.retention.title: How long jobs and their logs are kept
settings.retention.intro: Finished jobs older than this are deleted every night, together with their logs (at least 1 day). Routine jobs are the ones that run all day: service checks and the cleanup itself.
settings.hint.job_retention_routine_days: Service checks and the cleanup, whatever their outcome.
settings.hint.job_retention_success_days: Every other job that succeeded or was cancelled.
settings.hint.job_retention_failed_days: Every other job that failed: they explain what went wrong.
settings.hint.job_retention_overrides: Optional, “type:days” separated by commas, for example scan_library:90,fetch_covers:7. It wins over the values above.
